cases.name: P-TwRuleB-frozenset-clean
cases.why: The builtin frozenset receives command-shaped data only; it must not become a lead. [INFERENCE] before values are source-based predictions, not measured.

cases.name: P-TwRuleB-namedtuple-clean
cases.why: A visible namedtuple factory and class constructor only retain data. [INFERENCE] before values are source-based predictions, not measured.

cases.name: S-TwRuleB-builtin-shadow-spawn
cases.why: A binding to subprocess.run replaces the builtin list exemption and the literal argv reaches a visible spawn. [INFERENCE] before values are source-based predictions, not measured.

cases.name: S-TwRuleB-del-builtin-restores-clean
cases.why: Deleting a shadowing binding to the builtin list restores the builtin; its constructor call is pure. [INFERENCE] before values are source-based predictions, not measured.

cases.name: S-TwRuleB-reset-helper-lead
cases.why: A reset drops the earlier helper binding; the next literal-argv call has no visible body in the fresh kernel. [INFERENCE] before values are source-based predictions, not measured.

cases.name: L-TwRuleB-imported-external-lead
cases.why: A function imported from outside the known-pure stdlib set receives a literal positional argv list. [INFERENCE] before values are source-based predictions, not measured.

cases.name: W-TwRuleB-cross-cell-kwargs-observed
cases.why: An earlier-cell helper accepts keyword argv and forwards it through **kw to subprocess.run; the observed spawn path remains visible. [INFERENCE] before values are source-based predictions, not measured.
